_meta.description: Skill tree nodes and edges for STM31733 Network Administration

nodes.label: Network Admin Concepts
nodes.description: Understanding the role, scope and importance of network administration in managing a network environment.

nodes.label: FCAPS Model
nodes.description: Fault, Configuration, Accounting, Performance and Security management — the five pillars of network administration.

nodes.label: NOC Functions
nodes.description: The purpose and core functions of a Network Operations Center (NOC).

nodes.label: NOC Team Roles
nodes.description: Roles and responsibilities within a NOC team (Tier 1–3 engineers, NOC Manager, etc.).

nodes.label: Network Admin Best Practices
nodes.description: Industry best practices for maintaining a healthy, secure and well-documented network environment.

nodes.label: VLAN Types
nodes.description: Default, Data, Voice, Native, Management and Reserved VLANs — purpose and use cases.

nodes.label: VLAN Trunking Concepts
nodes.description: IEEE 802.1Q trunking — purpose, operation and configuration considerations.

nodes.label: Static Routing
nodes.description: Static routing concepts — manually configured routes, default routes, administrative distance.

nodes.label: Dynamic Routing Protocols
nodes.description: Overview of IGPs (RIP, OSPF, EIGRP) and EGPs (BGP) — differences, use cases, convergence.

nodes.label: Server Types & Usage
nodes.description: File, print, DNS, DHCP, web and application server types — roles in a small network.

nodes.label: Network Operating Systems
nodes.description: NOS architecture, NOS vs general-purpose OS, open-source NOS options, hardware requirements.

nodes.label: Initial Device Configuration
nodes.description: Configuring hostname, enable secret, local users, console/VTY authentication, password encryption, MOTD banner and saving config.

nodes.label: VLAN Configuration
nodes.description: Creating VLANs, assigning ports, adding descriptions and configuring the management interface.

nodes.label: Trunk Port Configuration
nodes.description: Configuring 802.1Q trunk ports between switches and verifying trunk status.

nodes.label: Inter-VLAN Routing
nodes.description: Configuring router-on-a-stick subinterfaces or Layer 3 switch SVIs for inter-VLAN communication.

nodes.label: Static Route Configuration
nodes.description: Configuring and verifying static and default routes on Cisco routers using ip route commands.

nodes.label: RIPv2 Configuration
nodes.description: Enabling RIPv2, advertising networks, verifying routing table and troubleshooting RIP adjacencies.

nodes.label: DHCP Configuration
nodes.description: Creating a DHCP pool on a router — specifying network, excluded addresses and default gateway.

nodes.label: DNS Configuration
nodes.description: Configuring DNS on a router (ip name-server) and on a Packet Tracer server (DNS service setup).

nodes.label: Ping & Connectivity Testing
nodes.description: Using ping to verify Layer 3 connectivity — interpreting echo-request / echo-reply results.

nodes.label: Traceroute Analysis
nodes.description: Using traceroute to identify where packets are dropped along the path.

nodes.label: Ipconfig / IP Verification
nodes.description: Using ipconfig and show commands to verify IP addressing, subnet masks and default gateways.

nodes.label: Netstat & Connection Analysis
nodes.description: Using netstat to display active connections, routing tables and listening ports.

nodes.label: Nslookup & DNS Verification
nodes.description: Using nslookup to verify DNS resolution and diagnose name resolution failures.

nodes.label: Systematic Troubleshooting
nodes.description: Applying a structured OSI-layer troubleshooting methodology to diagnose complex network faults.

nodes.label: SNMP Configuration
nodes.description: Configuring SNMP on Cisco devices for network monitoring — community strings, SNMP traps, MIB basics.

nodes.label: SSH Secure Management
nodes.description: Enabling SSH on Cisco routers and switches — generating RSA keys, setting SSH version, disabling Telnet.

nodes.label: Telnet (Legacy Awareness)
nodes.description: Understanding Telnet limitations (plaintext), why SSH is preferred, and how to disable Telnet access.

nodes.label: Install Monitoring Tool
nodes.description: Installing a network monitoring application (e.g. Wireshark) on a management station.

nodes.label: Configure Monitoring Tool
nodes.description: Configuring the monitoring tool to collect, display and alert on network performance metrics.

nodes.label: Generate Monitoring Report
nodes.description: Generating, interpreting and presenting a network monitoring report from collected data.

nodes.label: Group Discussion Skills
nodes.description: Participating effectively in group discussions on network monitoring topics using relevant software.

nodes.label: Network Monitoring Presentation
nodes.description: Presenting a network monitoring traffic analysis report to peers and lecturer.

nodes.label: Professional Presentation
nodes.description: Clear, structured and professional technical communication — verbal and slide-based presentation.

nodes.label: Professional Documentation
nodes.description: Producing well-structured technical documents following industry standards.
